verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses, laying out the festival schedule: 📣
‘Tell Israel: these are Yahweh’s set festivals—holy meet-ups you must announce right on schedule. 📅
‘Work six days, then day seven is a full-rest Sabbath and a holy gathering. No work that day; wherever you live, it’s Yahweh’s Sabbath. 🕊️
‘These are Yahweh’s appointed festivals—holy gatherings to announce when their time comes. 📜
‘Yahweh’s Passover starts at twilight on day fourteen of month one. Lock in the date. 🌙
On day fifteen, Yahweh’s Festival of Unleavened Bread begins. Unleavened bread is on the menu for seven days. 🍞
Day one is a holy gathering; pause the regular work and come worship. 🙏
Bring Yahweh a fire offering on each of the seven days. Day seven is another holy gathering—no regular work.’ 🔥
Yahweh spoke to Moses with the next part of the calendar: 📣
‘Tell Israel: when you enter the land I’m giving you and harvest its crops, bring the priest the first sheaf—the first cut of your harvest. 🌾
The priest must lift that sheaf before Yahweh so it’s accepted for you. This happens the day after the Sabbath. 🙌
On sheaf-presentation day, offer Yahweh a flawless male lamb, one year old, as a burnt offering. 🐑
With it, bring two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a fire offering—a pleasing aroma to Yahweh—and a quarter hin of wine as the drink offering. 🍷
Don’t eat bread, roasted grain, or fresh grain until you’ve brought this offering to your God. This rule stays in place for every generation, wherever you live. 🌾
‘Starting the day after the Sabbath, when you bring the sheaf for the wave offering, count out seven full weeks. 📆
On the day after the seventh week, count fifty days and present Yahweh with a new grain offering. 📆
Bring two loaves from your homes as a wave offering, made from two tenths of an ephah of fine flour and baked with yeast as first fruits for Yahweh. 🍞
Present with the bread seven flawless year-old lambs, one young bull, and two rams as a burnt offering to Yahweh, with their grain and drink offerings—a fire offering and pleasing aroma to Yahweh. 🐏
Also offer one male goat as a sin offering and two year-old male lambs as a peace offering. 🐐
The priest will lift them with the first-fruit bread and the two lambs as a wave offering before Yahweh. They will be holy to Yahweh and belong to the priest. 🙌
On that same day, announce a holy gathering. Do no regular work. This is a lasting rule for every generation wherever you live. 📢
‘When you harvest your land, don’t reap to the field’s edges or collect every last bit. Leave some for the poor and the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’ 🌾
Yahweh spoke to Moses. 📣
‘Tell the Israelites: On the first day of the seventh month, keep a day of rest, marked by trumpet blasts, and gather for worship. 📯
Do no regular work, and present a fire offering to Yahweh.’ 🔥
Yahweh spoke to Moses. 📣
‘But the tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. Gather for worship, deny yourselves, and present a fire offering to Yahweh. 🙏
Do no work that day, because it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before Yahweh your God. 🕊️
Anyone who refuses to deny themselves that day must be cut off from their people. ⚠️
I will destroy anyone among your people who does any work that day. ⚖️
Do no work. This is a lasting rule for every generation wherever you live. 📜
It is a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. Keep this Sabbath from the evening of the ninth day until the following evening.’ 🌙
Yahweh spoke to Moses. 📣
‘Tell the Israelites: The fifteenth day of this seventh month begins the Festival of Shelters to Yahweh, lasting seven days. 🛖
The first day is a holy gathering; do no regular work. 🙏
For seven days, present fire offerings to Yahweh. On the eighth day, gather for worship and present a fire offering. It is a solemn assembly; do no regular work. 🔥
‘These are Yahweh’s appointed festivals. Announce them as holy gatherings and present fire offerings—burnt offerings, grain offerings, sacrifices, and drink offerings—each on its assigned day, 📅
in addition to Yahweh’s Sabbaths, your gifts, all your vowed offerings, and all your freewill offerings to Yahweh. 🎁
‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the land’s harvest, celebrate Yahweh’s festival for seven days. Rest on the first day and the eighth day. 🌾
On the first day, take fruit from beautiful trees, palm branches, leafy branches, and willows from the stream, and celebrate before Yahweh your God for seven days. 🌴
Celebrate this festival to Yahweh for seven days each year. This is a lasting rule for every generation; keep it in the seventh month. 🎉
Live in temporary shelters for seven days; everyone native-born in Israel must live in shelters, 🛖
so future generations will remember that I made the Israelites live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’ 🏕️
Moses announced Yahweh’s appointed festivals to the Israelites. 📢
